Card Q&A.a: If you have a Digimon with [Three Musketeers] in its type in play in your battle area, you can use this Option card even if you don’t have a black Digimon or Tamer in play.
Card Q&A.q: "If you have a Digimon with [Three Musketeers] in its type in play, you may use this Option card without meeting its color requirements.” How does this effect work, exactly?

Card Q&A.a: Yes. Both your and your opponent delete all Digimon with play costs of 7 or less.
Card Q&A.q: Does this card’s effect also delete all of my Digimon with play costs of 7 or less?

Effect: If you have a Digimon with [Three Musketeers] in its type in play, you may use this Option card without meeting its color requirements.
[Main] Delete all Digimon with play costs of 7 or less.
Security Effect: [Security] Add this card to its owner's hand.
